assertion_analysis.condition: Fails if the strict-arm bisection does not converge to adjacent binary64 offsets.
Fail when the repaired census drops a root or a saddle at either side of the bisected pair; the strict-admission mutation made this assertion red in review-negative-control.log.
Fail if a polish seeded a quarter pitch away from the census reading does not return to it, is not hyperbolic, or carries a different flux.
Fails if the retained saddle does not persist across the pair within five percent of a pitch.
Fails if the production sampler read is invalid, loses a root, selects an X-point away from a separate polish, or if the booked current disagrees with the independent quadrature beyond rel=0.15.
Fails if the census rebuilt with the dropped step restored does not lose a saddle, or if the repaired census loses one.
